abstract: This paper emphasizes the need for good engineering in the production of stereo films to insure conformity with normal patterns of psycho-physiological functions of binocular vision. It describes the impact of stereoscopic motion pictures on the ophthalmic world and outlines some of the therapeutic benefits from viewing stereoscopic motion pictures. An orderly program is needed to inform the public of the potent stimulation to good binocular vision which results from viewing properly produced and projected stereoscopic motion pictures.
